lead.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎治疗新进展与衰弱管理
lead.titleEn: New Advances in Knee Osteoarthritis Treatment and Frailty Management
lead.paragraphZh: 今日头条聚焦骨科与肌骨领域，带来多条高质量循证信息。其中，一篇RCT比较了血流限制与中等强度阻力训练在膝骨关节炎中的应用，提供了高分证据。此外，两篇综述分别关注衰弱老年人的运动策略及数字化干预在骨关节炎患者体力活动轨迹中的作用，均值得临床PT关注。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's headlines focus on the Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal domain, presenting several high-quality evidence-based insights. A top-scoring RCT compares blood flow restriction with moderate-intensity resistive exercise for knee osteoarthritis, offering robust evidence. Additionally, two reviews address exercise strategies for frail older adults and the impact of digital interventions on physical activity trajectories in osteoarthritis patients, both warranting clinical PT attention.

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=75) on knee osteoarthritis patients compared passive blood flow restriction (BFR) at 50% and 70% limb occlusion pressure (LOP) with moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT). MI-RT yielded greater quadriceps strength. BFR-70% LOP significantly improved lower-extremity functional ability with less perceived exertion, while BFR-50% LOP showed smaller improvements.
items.curatedReason: 如果膝关节骨关节炎患者无法耐受常规中等强度阻力训练，那么 70% 肢体血流阻断压下的被动血流限制训练值得考虑。这项 RCT 表明，它能有效改善下肢功能，且患者感知劳累程度较低，优于 50% LOP，但对股四头肌力量的提升不如中等强度阻力训练。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者的血流限制联合不同负荷与中等强度阻力训练的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对膝骨关节炎患者的单盲随机对照试验（75 例），比较了 50% 和 70% 肢体血流阻断压（LOP）下的被动血流限制（BFR）与中等强度阻力训练（MI-RT）。MI-RT 产生了更大的股四头肌力量增益。70% LOP 的 BFR 显著改善了下肢功能能力，且感知劳累较低，而 50% LOP 的 BFR 改善较小。
items.curatedReasonEn: Consider passive blood flow restriction at 70% limb occlusion pressure for knee OA patients who cannot tolerate conventional moderate-intensity resistance training. This RCT shows it significantly improves lower-extremity function with less perceived exertion, outperforming 50% LOP, though it yields less quadriceps strength gain than MI-RT.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，无法排除研究者偏倚对结果的影响，且未提供长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is single-blinded, so researcher bias cannot be excluded, and long-term follow-up data are not provided.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study (n=15,197) of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients receiving digital education and exercise therapy found the proportion meeting recommended physical activity (PA) levels increased from 51.4% to 58.5% at one year. Four PA trajectories were identified (persistently high 41.2%, persistently low 30.4%, increasing 16.5%, declining 11.9%), with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项大样本纵向研究显示，数字化教育与运动疗法能有效提升膝/髋骨关节炎患者的体力活动水平，近六成患者达到或维持了推荐的活动量。这提示你，即使患者基线体力活动水平不高，这种干预模式也值得推荐，尤其要关注 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项针对 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝/髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，接受数字化教育和运动疗法后，达到推荐体力活动（PA）水平的患者比例在一年内从 51.4% 增至 58.5%。研究识别出四种 PA 轨迹（持续高水平 41.2%，持续低水平 30.4%，增长型 16.5%，下降型 11.9%），其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局都有可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample longitudinal study shows that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in knee/hip osteoarthritis patients, with nearly 60% reaching or maintaining recommended activity levels. This suggests that this intervention model is worthwhile, even for patients with low baseline physical activity, especially those with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 该研究基于注册数据，可能存在数据报告偏倚，且未提供关于干预具体内容和依从性的详细信息。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on registry data, which may involve reporting bias, and lacks detailed information on the specific intervention content and adherence.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This narrative review proposes a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercise in frail older adults. It suggests tailoring interventions based on dominant physiological limitations (e.g., resistance training for weakness, aerobic training for dyspnea, balance training for gait instability), with multicomponent exercise as a default. Formal validation of this treatment-matching algorithm is needed.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了衰弱老年人康复中运动干预的病理生理学导向优先级框架。它提示你，在制定干预方案时，应根据患者最主要的生理储备限制（如肌力不足、呼吸困难或步态不稳）来调整运动类型，确保个性化治疗。
items.titleZh: 衰弱中的运动优先级：一项基于病理生理学的叙述性综述，旨在指导老年人康复。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于确定衰弱老年人运动的优先级。它建议根据主要的生理限制（例如，针对虚弱进行阻力训练，针对呼吸困难进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练）来调整干预措施，并将多组分运动作为默认方案。该治疗匹配算法的正式验证仍是下一步研究方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed prioritization framework for exercise interventions in frail older adults. It suggests that when designing intervention programs, you should tailor exercise types based on the patient's most dominant physiological reserve limitations (e.g., muscle weakness, breathlessness, or gait instability) to ensure personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，证据主要来自衰弱队列、肌少症试验及其他老年运动研究的推断，缺乏直接的瓶颈匹配处方对比试验，结论仍需正式验证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review's evidence primarily extrapolates from frail cohorts, sarcopenia trials, and other older adult exercise studies, lacking direct trials of bottleneck-matched prescriptions, so conclusions require formal validation.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Austria explored physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, revealing perceived readiness for triage roles despite lacking a legal framework, moderate-to-high confidence in differential diagnosis but lower in red-flag screening, and identified needs for targeted training and interprofessional collaboration.
items.curatedReason: 在奥地利这样的转诊制国家，物理治疗师普遍认为自己有能力提供直接评估和治疗，但仍需正式的法律框架和红旗征象筛查的培训。这提示直接准入在全球推行时，除了临床技能，配套的法律、责任和跨专业协作机制也是关键。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊制下物理治疗师对直接准入的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在奥地利进行的定性研究探讨了物理治疗师对直接准入的看法。结果显示，物理治疗师普遍认为自己已在非正式地进行直接准入的初级评估工作，但在鉴别诊断方面信心较高，在红旗征象筛查方面信心较低。研究强调了正式培训、跨专业合作和报销机制对于安全公平实施直接准入的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In referral-based systems like Austria, physiotherapists feel competent for direct access but need formal legal frameworks and red-flag screening training. This highlights that successful global direct access implementation requires not just clinical skills, but also supportive legal, liability, and interprofessional collaboration mechanisms.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10 名物理治疗师），结果可能不完全代表整个行业或推及其他地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative exploratory study with a small sample size (10 physiotherapists), so the findings may not be fully representative of the profession or generalizable to other geographic regions.

items.title: A 10-week randomized controlled hip-strengthening intervention in healthy, well-trained runners: longitudinal and cross-sectional analyses of frontal-plane running biomechanics across running speeds
items.summary: A 10-week RCT (n=48) in healthy, trained runners found that a hip-strengthening intervention improved hip abductor strength (0.20–0.29 Nm/kg) but did not alter frontal-plane running biomechanics (e.g., knee abduction moments). Greater hip abductor strength was associated with higher knee abduction moments only at slow running speeds at baseline.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对健康训练有素的跑者进行 10 周的臀部肌力强化，尽管能提高肌力，但并未显著改变跑步时的额状面生物力学。在制定跑步损伤预防方案时，不要高估臀部肌力训练对额状面生物力学的直接影响。
items.titleZh: 对健康、训练有素的跑者进行 10 周随机对照髋部强化干预：不同跑步速度下额状面跑步生物力学的纵向和横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康、训练有素跑者的 10 周随机对照试验（48 例）发现，髋部强化干预提高了髋外展肌力量（0.20–0.29 Nm/kg），但并未改变额状面跑步生物力学（如膝关节外展力矩）。基线时，只有在慢速跑步时，较高的髋外展肌力量才与较高的膝关节外展力矩相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that 10 weeks of hip strengthening in healthy, well-trained runners, despite improving strength, did not significantly alter frontal-plane running biomechanics. When developing running injury prevention programs, do not overstate the direct impact of hip strengthening on frontal-plane biomechanics.
items.limitation: 本研究仅针对健康、训练有素的跑者，结果可能不适用于存在跑步相关损伤或体能水平较低的人群。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on healthy, well-trained runners, so the results may not be applicable to individuals with running-related injuries or lower fitness levels.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (21 studies) mapped evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF). It found very limited direct evidence for WBV or LSE specifically in FF, with most insights derived from related populations. The effectiveness and safety of these interventions in FF remain uncertain, highlighting a need for RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者步态控制的证据极为有限，现有证据多来自相关人群。在临床实践中，若无针对柔性扁平足的直接 RCT 证据，应谨慎应用这些干预措施。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者姿势控制的影响：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述（21 项研究）梳理了全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定训练（LSE）对柔性扁平足（FF）患者姿势控制的证据。研究发现，针对 FF 的 WBV 或 LSE 直接证据非常有限，多数见解来自相关人群。这些干预措施在 FF 患者中的有效性和安全性仍不确定，亟需随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates extremely limited evidence for whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises improving postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot, with most existing evidence from related populations. In clinical practice, apply these interventions cautiously without direct RCT evidence for flexible flatfoot.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，主要旨在识别研究空白，而非评估干预措施的有效性，且纳入的大多数证据来自与柔性扁平足相关的其他人群。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review primarily aims to identify research gaps rather than evaluate intervention effectiveness, and most included evidence is from populations related to flexible flatfoot.

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study introduced ScoreE, an isokinetic dynamometry metric, to objectively quantify post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance in 35 patients. ScoreE demonstrated good to excellent inter-rater (ICC 0.81-0.89) and test-retest reliability (ICC 0.76-0.93), with moderate associations with Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) grades, providing a reliable tool for longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提出了一种新的等速测力学指标ScoreE，用于客观量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。该指标具有良好的评定者间和重测信度（ICC范围0.76-0.93），且与MAS量表评分中度相关。ScoreE为客观监测卒中痉挛和评估干预效果提供了一个有潜力的工具，有助于你更精准地评估患者进展。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗的常模扭矩-轮廓方法：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究引入了等速测力学指标ScoreE，以客观量化35名卒中患者的肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。ScoreE表现出良好至卓越的评定者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和重测信度（ICC 0.76-0.93），并与改良Ashworth量表（MAS）评分呈中度相关，为长期监测提供了一个可靠工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric for objectively quantifying post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. The metric demonstrates good to excellent inter-rater and test-retest reliability (ICC range 0.76-0.93) and moderate associations with MAS grades. ScoreE offers a promising tool for objectively monitoring stroke spasticity and evaluating intervention effects, helping you more precisely assess patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（35名卒中患者），且对振动干预后的反应性评估为探索性，未进行正式评估，需更大规模研究验证其临床敏感性和响应性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (35 stroke patients), and the responsiveness to vibration intervention was exploratory without formal assessment, requiring larger studies to validate clinical sensitivity and responsiveness.

items.title: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summary: An exploratory study (n=8 chronic stroke survivors) using directional EMG mapping found that severely impaired participants exhibited restricted upper-limb force generation in lateral directions and narrow medial activation tuning, correlated with larger angular errors. Force demands and task direction modulated these deficits, suggesting patient-specific vulnerable zones and enhanced shoulder-driven control strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究通过定向肌电图揭示了卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性改变，尤其在重度受损患者中存在方向性限制和代偿策略。这提示你在设计个性化康复干预时，应考虑患者特定的“脆弱区域”和力/方向的复杂交互作用。
items.titleZh: 定向肌电图模式揭示卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性破坏。
items.summaryZh: 一项使用定向肌电图映射的探索性研究（8 名慢性卒中幸存者）发现，重度受损的参与者在侧向力产生和内侧激活调谐方面表现出受限，这与更大的角度误差相关。力的需求和任务方向调节了这些缺陷，提示存在患者特定的脆弱区域和增强的肩驱动控制策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study, using directional EMG, reveals impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke, particularly directional limitations and compensatory strategies in severely impaired individuals. This suggests that when designing personalized rehabilitation interventions, you should consider patient-specific "vulnerable zones" and the complex interplay of force and direction.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（8 名慢性卒中幸存者），且缺乏对照组，无法确立干预措施的有效性，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (8 chronic stroke survivors) and lacks a control group, making it unable to establish intervention efficacy and limiting generalizability.

items.title: Exercise interventions for gait and balance performances among older adults with sarcopenic obesity: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (13 studies, n=502) on exercise interventions for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity found exercise training (power, resistance, multicomponent) improved gait speed, step length, functional mobility, static balance, and postural control, with mild adverse effects. Most studies (nearly 70%) were on older women, limiting generalizability to older men.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，运动训练对肌少性肥胖老年人的步态和平衡表现有潜在益处。在为这类患者设计康复方案时，可优先考虑力量训练、有氧训练及多组分训练，但需注意现有研究多集中于老年女性，对老年男性的普适性仍待进一步证实。
items.titleZh: 肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡表现的运动干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡运动干预的范围综述（13 项研究，502 例）发现，运动训练（力量、阻力、多组分）改善了步态速度、步长、功能活动度、静态平衡和姿势控制，且不良反应轻微。大多数研究（近 70%）针对老年女性，限制了结果对老年男性的普适性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates potential benefits of exercise training for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity. When designing rehabilitation programs for this population, prioritize power, resistance, and multicomponent training, but be aware that current research primarily focuses on older women, and generalizability to older men needs further confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入的 13 项研究中近 70% 仅针对老年女性，因此结果对老年男性的普适性存疑。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review includes 13 studies, nearly 70% of which focused solely on older women, raising questions about the generalizability of the findings to older men.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study
items.summary: This longitudinal study examined the association between time-varying social integration and long-term all-cause and cause-specific mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI). It emphasizes that despite advances in acute care and rehabilitation, life expectancy for SCI patients remains shorter, with social and environmental factors playing a significant role in long-term outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）患者长期社会融入程度对全因和特定原因死亡率的影响。这提示您，在制定 SCI 患者的康复计划时，除了传统的功能恢复，还应重视他们的社会参与和生活质量，因为这直接关系到他们的长期生存预后。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后时变社会融入与长期全因和特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向研究探讨了创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后时变社会融入与长期全因和特定原因死亡率之间的关联。研究强调，尽管急性护理和康复取得了进展，SCI 患者的预期寿命仍低于一般人群，社会和环境因素在长期预后中发挥着重要作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the impact of long-term social integration on all-cause and cause-specific mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI). This suggests that when developing rehabilitation plans for SCI patients, you should prioritize their social participation and quality of life, in addition to traditional functional recovery, as these directly relate to their long-term survival prognosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，虽然显示了相关性，但无法确立社会融入与死亡率之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study, and while it shows correlation, it cannot establish a causal relationship between social integration and mortality.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Physical and mental health outcomes of organized sports participation in adult women: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (16 studies, n=6,271 women) found that organized sports participation significantly improved VO₂peak (MD = 1.51), reduced depression (MD = -5.30), increased social capital (MD = +7.30), reduced fat mass (MD = -1.14 kg), and increased lean mass (MD = 0.90 kg) in adult women. Benefits extended to bone formation, occupational functioning, and social connectedness.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析坐实了参与有组织的体育运动能显著改善成年女性的体能、心理健康和生活质量，且其社会和结构维度放大了非结构性运动的益处。在推广女性健康和康复时，你应积极整合有组织的体育活动。
items.titleZh: 成年女性参与有组织的体育运动对身心健康的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（16 项研究，6,271 名女性）发现，成年女性参与有组织的体育运动显著改善了最大摄氧量（平均差 = 1.51），降低了抑郁（平均差 = -5.30），增加了社会资本（平均差 = +7.30），减少了脂肪量（平均差 = -1.14 公斤），并增加了瘦体重（平均差 = 0.90 公斤）。益处还扩展到骨骼形成、职业功能和社会联系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 6,271 women confirms that organized sports are a potent, multidimensional intervention for adult women's health. Not only does it significantly improve VO₂peak (MD = 1.51) and reduce depression (MD = -5.30), but its social and structural dimensions amplify benefits. You should actively recommend and integrate organized sports into women's health and rehabilitation promotion.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析纳入的 RCT 存在低至中度的内部效度风险，非随机设计存在高偏倚风险，这可能影响证据的整体强度。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis include RCTs with low to moderate risk of internal validity and non-randomized designs with high risk of bias, which may affect the overall strength of the evidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of mesenchymal stem cell-Derived secretome injection on functional outcomes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction using peroneus longus tendon autograft: a double-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (n=24) comparing ACL reconstruction with peroneus longus tendon autograft with or without mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived secretome injection found the secretome group had significantly higher IKDC (86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01) and Tegner–Lysholm scores (87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01) at six months post-op. No major adverse events were reported.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，在 ACL 重建手术中辅助注射 MSC 衍生的分泌组可提高 6 个月后的患者报告膝关节功能评分。尽管结果积极，但样本量小，且仅为短期功能结局，尚不能将其作为常规临床实践，应等待更大样本和长期随访的研究结果。
items.titleZh: 间充质干细胞分泌组注射对腓骨长肌腱自体移植物前交叉韧带重建术后功能结局的影响：一项双盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（24 例）比较了采用腓骨长肌腱自体移植物进行前交叉韧带（ACL）重建术后是否辅助注射间充质干细胞（MSC）分泌组。结果显示，分泌组在术后 6 个月时 IKDC 评分（86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01）和 Tegner–Lysholm 评分（87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01）显著更高。未报告主要不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample RCT suggests that adjunctive injection of MSC-derived secretome during ACL reconstruction may improve patient-reported knee function scores at 6 months. While positive, the small sample size and short-term functional outcomes mean it cannot be adopted as routine clinical practice yet; larger trials with long-term follow-up are needed.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量非常小（24 名参与者），随访期仅为 6 个月，且关注的是患者报告结局而非生物学愈合指标，结果的长期有效性和生物学机制仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study has a very small sample size (24 participants) and a follow-up period of only 6 months. It focuses on patient-reported outcomes rather than biological healing markers, so the long-term efficacy and biological mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: The effect of empowerment based on 5 A model on fall self-efficacy, self-care and quality of life in older adults: a parallel randomized clinical trial
items.summary: A parallel randomized clinical trial (n=110 older adults) found that a 12-week empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy (p < 0.001), self-care (p < 0.001), and quality of life (p < 0.001) in the intervention group compared to routine care. The mean age of participants was 68.28 ± 3.14 years.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，基于 5A 模型的赋能干预显著提升了老年人的跌倒自我效能、自我护理能力和生活质量。这提示你在制定老年跌倒预防和健康促进方案时，可以积极采用这种赋能模式。
items.titleZh: 基于 5A 模型的赋能干预对老年人跌倒自我效能、自我护理和生活质量的影响：一项平行随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项平行随机临床试验（110 名老年人）发现，与常规护理相比，基于 5A 模型的 12 周赋能干预显著改善了干预组的跌倒自我效能（p < 0.001）、自我护理（p < 0.001）和生活质量（p < 0.001）。参与者的平均年龄为 68.28 ± 3.14 岁。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that an empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy, self-care, and quality of life in older adults. This suggests you can actively adopt this empowerment model when developing fall prevention and health promotion programs for the elderly.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，结果在不同文化背景和医疗系统下的普适性可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center trial, and the generalizability of its findings to different cultural backgrounds and healthcare systems may require further validation.
